Artificial Intelligence is already revolutionizing our world. But with these innovations come serious risks.

Proud to be named Vice Chair of @NewDemCoalition’s AI Working Group to help drive a balance of policy that promotes innovation while protecting public interests. https://t.co/LGTa2itPGj
statements.quoted:
🚨New Dems just announced our first-ever AI Working Group!

This Working Group will develop and advance forward-thinking policies that both encourage innovation and guard against potential risks posed by this emerging technology. https://t.co/yb10QRTJRc

statements.text: As a Tartan, I was especially proud to welcome my alma mater, Carnegie Mellon University, to Capitol Hill to talk about the future of AI policy. [...] AI is the next frontier for the world, including for policymakers on the Hill, and because it's such a critical issue, I'm proud to see that both Democrats and Republicans can come together to listen to the experts and pave the way for policies that will drive our country forward in a safe and responsible manner.
statements.venue: Press release/CMU Heinz College news on New Democrat Coalition AI Working Group roundtable

statements.text:
This week, I joined my @ProbSolveCaucus colleagues @RepJoshG and @RepWilliams for #TechNetDay.

Working together is critical for building an economy that can safely and responsibly unlock the power of AI for small businesses, workforce, and consumers. https://t.co/hmuE3Dswla
Innovators at @Droisys in Las Vegas are helping grow southern Nevada’s tech and business industries with their cutting edge AI, machine learning, and gaming initiatives. https://t.co/NNcNuX8BIA

.@Switch is bringing the cutting edge of AI innovation right here to southern Nevada. On Friday, I was proud to welcome @RepJeffries to tour their new AI factory and meet the union workers who make it all possible.

Their new factories will create hundreds of jobs, continuing to diversify our economy. As Nevada families and businesses continue to feel the impact of plummeting tourism rates, this is more important than ever.

Real or AI-generated images, shared without consent, have no place on the internet or anywhere. That’s why I cosponsored the bipartisan TAKE IT DOWN Act to deliver real change. 

Now victims are getting the justice they deserve ⬇️

https://t.co/nPLsYp2xHd

It’s always so wonderful when I get to welcome @lvchamber to Washington. 

From tackling artificial intelligence to building more housing, I’m working across the aisle to deliver real change for Nevada’s employers and entrepreneurs. It was great answering your questions and updating you on what your representatives are doing in Congress. Thank you all for coming!
